coverage.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml:12-20 says nightly takes latest, beta takes nightly and stable takes beta (the Run button), and self-hosters pick a channel by the image tag ghcr.io/nomercylabs/nomnomzbot:stable|beta|nightly. The crons at release.yml:26-27 ('0 3 * * *' nightly, '0 4 * * 1' beta Monday) match the table's 03:00 and Monday 04:00 UTC. .github/workflows/ci.yml:180-209 tags latest only after the test, dashboard and build jobs succeed on master, which supports 'newest build that passed its tests'.

docker-compose.lite.yml:20-21 says 'ONE container only... To update: pull the new image and run docker compose -f docker-compose.lite.yml up -d'. That matches the page's pull and up -d commands and its one-container short pause.

docker-compose.lite.yml:31 has image: ${API_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/nomercylabs/nomnomzbot:stable}, so an empty API_IMAGE runs stable. The page's contrast for the full setup is supported by docker-compose.yml:65, image: ${API_IMAGE:-nomnomzbot-api:local}, with a build section at 66-68.

.env.example:37-39 says ENCRYPTION_KEY is the AES key for OAuth token storage and 'Changing this invalidates all stored OAuth tokens (the bot must re-auth)', which matches the page's ENCRYPTION_KEY callout.

DEPLOY.md:161-165 says not to point watchtower or any auto-updater at api-blue/api-green, because its stop-then-start update is downtime and it cannot wait for /health/ready. The lite half of the callout follows from docker-compose.lite.yml:20-21 (update is pull plus up -d) and from server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Program.cs:517, which runs migrator.MigrateAsync at startup.

scripts/switchover.ps1:34-37 is the failure contract. Lines 177-180 stop the idle color and call Fail. Line 48 prints 'SWITCHOVER: FAILED - ...'. Line 40 sets ReadyTimeoutSec = 120 and line 20 documents -ReadyTimeoutSec 180. Line 192 prints 'SWITCHOVER: DONE' only after line 188 stops the old color. Lines 158-165 pull a registry ref and build only for a bare local tag.

docker-compose.lite.yml:16-18 and 23-24 keep all lite state and the generated secrets under /app/data on the volume named nomnomzbot_lite_data (71-77). docker-compose.yml:143-144, 195 and 246-248 back the full setup's postgres_data and api_data volumes. Both colors share api_data through the x-api-service anchor at docker-compose.yml:61-68 and 168-174, which supports 'both colors use the same data' and restoring data and keys together.

reader_answers.evidence: The channel, the API_IMAGE setting, the lite pull and up -d, and the full-setup switchover are supported by release.yml:12-18, docker-compose.lite.yml:20-21 and 31, and scripts/switchover.ps1:158-165. Database changes at start are supported by Program.cs:517 (MigrateAsync). Losing sign-ins when the key changes is supported by .env.example:38.

The backup is needed because startup migrates the database (Program.cs:517). PowerShell is needed because the switchover is a .ps1 script (scripts/switchover.ps1). API_IMAGE must be set for the full setup because an empty value defaults to the local build nomnomzbot-api:local (docker-compose.yml:65).

The lite healthcheck at docker-compose.lite.yml:60-65 is what reports healthy. scripts/switchover.ps1:188-192 prints 'SWITCHOVER: DONE' after the new color is ready and the old one is stopped. The channels differ by tag and cadence per release.yml:14-16 and 26-27.

DEPLOY.md:161-165 forbids pointing watchtower at api-blue/api-green because its stop-then-start causes downtime and it does not wait for /health/ready. scripts/switchover.ps1:165-188 starts the new color next to the old one and stops the old one only after the readiness check.
